bib.title: Scaling Vision with Sparse Mixture of Experts

read.skipped: Plot tick numbers (axis values) skimmed only; text and tables read in full.

question: Can sparse conditional computation (mixture of experts) scale Vision Transformers to match dense state of the art with less compute?
hypothesis: Sparse MoE layers in ViT give better quality at the same compute, or the same quality at lower compute, than dense models.
contributions: Vision models at scale: V-MoE up to 24 MoE layers, 32 experts per layer, almost 15B parameters, 90.35% ImageNet
Outperforms dense counterparts upstream, few-shot and fine-tuned; can match largest dense model at about half the inference compute
Batch Prioritized Routing for adaptive per-image compute

method.summary: Vision MoE (V-MoE): replace a subset of ViT MLP blocks with sparse MoE layers (32 experts, top-k routing applied after softmax, per-patch routing, fixed expert buffer capacity, importance+load auxiliary losses). Pretrain on JFT-300M, transfer by linear few-shot and full fine-tuning; add Batch Prioritized Routing (BPR) that ranks tokens by max routing weight so low capacity C drops the least useful patches; scale to 14.7B (V-MoE-15B) on JFT-3B.

datasets.name: ImageNet (ILSVRC2012)
datasets.split: few-shot 1/5/10 (and 25 in Table 9) shots per class; full fine-tune on ~1M train; eval on validation

datasets.name: ImageNet-21k
datasets.preprocessing: RandAugment N=2 M=10 in one ablation

models.name: V-MoE (S/32,B/32,B/16,L/32,L/16,H/14)
models.params: 36.5M dense S/32 up to 7160.8M (H/14 Every-2); L/16 Every-2 3446.0M
models.architecture: ViT with MoE MLP layers on every other block (Every-2) or last-n even blocks (Last-n); E=32 experts, k=2 default

other.hyperparams: Table 8 gives blocks/heads/embed/MLP per variant, e.g. H/14: 32 blocks, 16 heads, 1280, 5120

models.name: V-MoE-15B
models.architecture: 48 blocks, 16 heads, embed 1408, MLP 6400, Every-2, E=32, k=2; bfloat16 moving average, rsqrt lr, new attention head

training.objective: multilabel classification loss on JFT plus lambda * auxiliary loss, L_aux = 0.5 L_imp + 0.5 L_load (squared coefficient of variation)
training.lr: base LR by variant: S/32 1e-3, B 8e-4, L/32 6e-4, L/16 4e-4, H/14 3e-4, V-MoE-15B 8e-4
training.lr_schedule: linear decay; rsqrt with final linear cooldown for V-MoE-15B
training.seq_len: inferred: 256 patches at 224x224 with 14x14 patches (paper text); 730 patches at 384x384
training.precision: bfloat16 for gradient moving average (V-MoE-15B); otherwise float32
training.weight_decay: 0.1 on all params (0.03 kernels and 3 for head in V-MoE-15B)
training.regularisation: router noise std 1/E; auxiliary loss lambda=0.01
training.compute: Table 8 ExaFLOPs and TPUv3-days per model; V-MoE-15B 33.9k ExaFLOPs, 16.8k TPUv3-core-days
training.seeds: BPR training figures mean over 4 seeds; ImageNet fine-tune averaged over 3 runs; others not stated

other.finetune_steps_and_lr: ImageNet 10,000 steps, LR in {0.003,0.01,0.03,0.06}; CIFAR10/100 2,500 steps; Pets/Flowers 250 steps; VTAB 1,250 steps LR 0.001; V-MoE-15B ImageNet 560x560, 30,000 steps (~6 epochs), LR 0.006, Polyak momentum 0.999999
other.few_shot: linear regression on frozen features to one-hot labels

inference.samples: not stated for inference; ImageNet fine-tune averaged over 3 runs

parameters.C: capacity ratio, 1.05 upstream; 0.1-1.0 swept at inference with BPR

limits: Authors suspect the fine-tuning protocol is not tuned for sparse models (Sec 3.5).
On VTAB, V-MoE-H/14 matches ViT within confidence intervals.
Dense models need less runtime at equal FLOPs because of cross-device data transfer (Sec 4.2).
V-MoE does not help on ImageNet-21k pretraining without RandAugment (overfitting) and loses at 9M JFT images.
Batch size, warmup, hardware counts are not stated; JFT is not public.
Router outputs encode expert-token fit, not token importance; BPR uses them as a proxy.
Hyperparameters tuned for transfer, not JFT precision.

terms.definition: sort tokens across the whole batch by max routing weight before allocating expert buffer slots, so low-priority tokens are dropped when capacity C is small
